data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 潮汐归途的无言守望
data.action: 驻足在及膝潮涌中，单手立起冲浪板插入湿砂，侧身远眺
data.location: 深海悬崖天然凹湾沙砾滩
data.lighting: 暮色天际清冷的灰紫晚霞与潮水微光
data.camera: low angle, wide shot, 壮阔低机位仰视，冲浪板立于潮涌与海崖
data.description: 冷冽巨浪翻涌的深海峭壁之下，退潮后的砂砾滩泛着湿漉的水光。斯卡蒂赤足驻足在及膝的潮涌中，单手立起重型冲浪板插入黑砂。暮色渐深，灰紫色的晚霞与她的红瞳相互映衬，海风吹拂着她微湿的银发，她沉默地守在身侧，静听潮汐退去。
data.promptProse: Standing knee-deep within heavy coastal surf beneath towering dark sea cliffs, Skadi rests one hand atop a heavy surfboard planted in the wet shore. Cool dusk twilight casts purple and grey hues across the churning sea while she gazes calmly out across the waves.
data.animaCaption: Standing knee-deep in the breaking coastal surf with her surfboard planted beside her, she watches the twilight tide under the sea cliffs.
